name: Kawi
description: A curious, compact canopy bird with dark-edged wings, a rust-colored breast and long expressive tail feathers that flick when it is curious. Often heard before it is seen.
habitatSummary: Forest canopy and bright woodland edges.

skills.name: Branch Hop
skills.description: Darts to a new perch, briefly raising its Speed.

skills.name: Curious Tilt
skills.description: Studies the opponent, revealing its next move.

attacks.name: Peck
attacks.description: A quick, precise jab of the short hooked beak.

attacks.name: Wing Buffet
attacks.description: Beats its dark-edged wings into the opponent's face.

marking.name: Pale-tailed
marking.description: Pale tips on the long tail feathers.

name: Mimu
description: A cautious, elongated forest mouse whose muted green-brown coloration blends into leaf litter and moss. It pauses often, listening before crossing open patches.
habitatSummary: Leaf litter, moss, roots and sheltered undergrowth.

skills.name: Leaf Litter Hide
skills.description: Vanishes into cover, raising its Defense.

skills.name: Seed Cache
skills.description: Eats a stored seed to restore a little HP.

attacks.name: Nibble
attacks.description: A quick nip with small, sharp teeth.

attacks.name: Scurry Strike
attacks.description: Darts out from cover and bumps into the opponent before slipping back.

marking.name: Moss-backed
marking.description: A greener stripe along the back.

name: Lumae
description: A small four-legged Wildkin with a leaf-like body and a flower-like growth along its back that opens and closes as it moves. Its presence is a sign of a healthy clearing.
habitatSummary: Sunny clearings with healthy flowering plants.

skills.name: Bloom
skills.description: Opens its dorsal flower, healing itself over time.

skills.name: Petal Veil
skills.description: Shields itself with a ring of petals.

attacks.name: Spore Puff
attacks.description: Its dorsal flower releases a puff of fine spores.

attacks.name: Leaf Shove
attacks.description: Pushes with its sturdy, leaf-like body.

marking.name: Twin-bloom
marking.description: Two dorsal flowers instead of one.

name: Kantar
description: A segmented, many-legged Wildkin with dark armored plates and pale markings along its sides. It hides beneath stones by day and slips away when surprised.
habitatSummary: Under rocks, fallen branches and damp forest floor.

skills.name: Plate Curl
skills.description: Curls its armored segments, sharply raising Defense.

skills.name: Quick Retreat
skills.description: Slips under cover and re-emerges with a counter.

attacks.name: Venom Nip
attacks.description: A defensive nip carrying a mild biological toxin. No real-world hazard is implied.

attacks.name: Plate Slam
attacks.description: Throws the weight of its armored segments against the opponent.

marking.name: Banded
marking.description: The pale side markings join into full bands.

name: Riverkin
description: A compact freshwater Wildkin with a thick body, short legs, a subtly shimmering surface and a powerful swimming tail. Its survival depends on continuous freshwater habitat.
habitatSummary: Flowing water, shaded banks and deeper pools.

skills.name: Cool Shade
skills.description: Rests in shade, cleansing one ailment.

attacks.name: Tail Slap
attacks.description: A heavy blow with its powerful swimming tail.
